note: Hand corrections for the blue tracker. Who is staff comes from the forums themselves: each forum's /en/wow/about.json staff list (read at most once a day) and Blizzard's own blue marker on posts (the group tracker). This file only adjusts that. include: always keep this person's posts in Forever and Classic categories, even if the forum does not list them. exclude: never keep this person. excludeTitles: never keep posts whose role is one of these forum titles. titles: show this role instead of the forum's title. Every entry names its region, us or eu; usernames are the forum's, with any numeric suffix.
